description: The top of one category's Substack leaderboard, with each writer's followers, paid band and move since the previous board. The result says when the board was read, matching the date on the category page. board is bestsellers (ranked by paid subscribers, the default) or rising (recent paid growth). category is a slug or name such as technology, business, culture or U.S. Politics; when it does not match, the result lists the closest categories.

category.description: A category slug or name, for example technology, us-politics or Food & Drink.
